title: Research unit ids with non-hex letters (fs05-01 style) are refused by script_run and six other scripts: widen the id pattern or rename the units
note: MEASURED 2026-11-01 (lane ML-RECIPE): script_run._ID_RE = RQ-\d{8}-(?:\d{3}|[0-9a-f]{4}-\d{2}); 'fs05' contains 's', not hex, so script_run --check refuses all four fs units ('is not RQ-YYYYMMDD-NNN'). The same pattern is enforced in dispatch_queue.py, research_result.py, research_queue.py, collect_runner_results.py, next_rq_id.py and kernel_main.py. Options: (a) widen the hex class to [0-9a-z] in all seven (loosens, adds no gate); (b) rename the four units to hex ids and fix references. Local runs by lane ML-RECIPE are unaffected meanwhile. Needs a decision on (a) vs (b).  ALSO: fs05-01/fs06-01 declare timeout_minutes 600 but script_run caps at 330 ([10, 330]); fix both (or split the units) when repairing the ids. [2026-11-05 lane ML-FS-RECIPE] POPULATION (MEASURED over find research/queue -name 'RQ-*.y*ml': 1984 files = 1861 active + 123 blocked/): 7 fail the id regex, ALL in blocked/ (fs01-01, fs02-01, fs05-01, fs06-01, and e18g-01/-02/-03 owned by DESK-18G); 0 of 1861 active units fail it, so no live unit is invisible to research-queue-dispatch. Timeout > 330: 4 units, all in blocked/ (fs01-01, fs05-01, fs06-01 at 600; fe57-02 at 360); 0 active. The four fs units are already graded locally (comms/research/RQ-20261101-fs0{1,5,6}-01 records; fs02-01 not checked), so widening the hex class would only let a graded unit re-fire as a duplicate ~10 h job: not done. Renaming a graded unit would orphan its record path: not done. Residual live defect = the three e18g units (needs DESK-18G rename to hex, per their blocked_on). Prevention: next_rq_id.py already issues hex ids; hand-authored ids are the only source, and a guard for that is a new gate (needs operator permission).

observation.what: RQ-20261101-fs01-01/-fs02-01/-fs05-01/-fs06-01 pass script_run --check (or are renamed to hex ids) so the runner can dispatch them
